notes.title: New game: "Discolored - Episode 2" official announcement!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Hope you are well! The new game I've been working on, [b]Discolored - Episode 2[/b] is officially announced! It took a bit longer to get everything ready (typical of game development) but finally I can start showing off what to expect in Episode 2!


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1859720/Discolored__Episode_2/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/22be0aa44bcd92381031d98cc84b5347ebaffa76.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1859720/Discolored__Episode_2/]View the Steam page for Episode 2![/url]

[h3]And now for a few teasers of what to expect from Episode 2![/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/9485df5a3486ffa2e231f2b41d6129ca7d05fd5c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/a36a7a01dd8de92d00d745516f97ccd8d2af477c.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/fb69ed2162f92a3654384886bb00130a24c5f0cf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/522a4ff5694d778b9c658a94583d3658c19b4f3f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/a76cf820880f5030b9b8ac43b317e2c5887ed766.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/11b3909625795b8e63e1972c0d1e177e210f6545.gif[/img]
Check out the game's Steam page (link above) where you can view the trailer and screenshots and if you like what you see it would really help if you could wishlist the game (please). :) Steam keeps track of how quickly and how many wishlists a game gets and if the numbers are high enough it will show the game to more people that browse Steam. In turn hopefully that will lead to the game doing well and I can continue to expand the world of Discolored.

This game will build out the story more and you will run into a couple of characters that can help or harm you in your quest to restore the missing colors. It will play mostly the same as Episode 1 with reality-bending puzzles, an atmospheric soundtrack, and a striking color palette. But there will also be more intense moments where you have to think on your feet because in this episode the evil organization that has stolen all the colors are trying to stop you from bringing them back.

[h3]Join the Newsletter or Discord[/h3]
Want to play the demo? If you'd like to take part in a beta test of the demo [url=https://www.jasongodbey.com/newsletter/]join the mailing list[/url] or [url=https://discord.com/invite/ZNDxF7puPS]Discord[/url] and I'll be sending out news later with instructions on how you can sign up to play the demo and give feedback. So sign up and stay tuned!
[url=https://www.jasongodbey.com/newsletter/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/3e2206ff9c63486fcbaf27e22f4f27ed4572609d.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/ZNDxF7puPS][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/1e16266dc9fb2bf7ead726fe3252a8c2b4079cee.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Release date?[/h3]
Right now I can't give a firm release date on when Episode 2 will be completed. I want to make this game much longer than the first episode. If I had to give a timeframe it might be another year and a half before Episode 2 is complete. But it's game dev, so it could be even be longer. But I'm really excited about the ideas I have for this one so I won't be giving up on it and I'll do everything I can to make it best game it can possibly be!


Thank you,
Jason

[i]
P.S. I'd love to hear what you think based on what you see on the Steam page. Feel free to reply to this thread to share your thoughts![/i]

notes.title: Discolored, a new puzzle-adventure, is out now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

In case you weren't aware, [b]Discolored is out now on Steam! [/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/933860/Discolored/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/933860/Discolored/[/url]

Discolored is a puzzle-adventure where all the colors have gone missing and it's up to you to bring them back! I started working on Discolored a few months after completing The Search and after 2 years of working on it in my spare time I'm excited to share it with you! 

And if you have The Search in your Steam library you should have the option to buy Discolored through the "Complete the Set" bundle at an extra discount! There's also a free digital art book DLC that comes with it sharing a few extra insights about the game.

I hope you enjoy Discolored and I would love to hear what you think of it! :)

-Jason

Thanks again!

notes.title: Announcing a new adventure game "Discolored"!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28409456/8ad5c689653ee2b8589c310cf0cd026d8470e68d.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,

Today I'm announcing a new upcoming puzzle-adventure game I've been making called Discolored!  You can head over to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/933860/Discolored/]Steam page[/url] to check out the trailer and to wishlist the game!

Below is a FAQ about the game:

[b]What is Discolored about?[/b] The story is as follows:
You arrive at the end of a desert highway where a small abandoned cafe sits and a strange tower looms overhead. As you look around you notice everything has lost its color. All objects that once held vibrant lush tones of color are now a pale grey.  What has caused the all the rich colors to disappear? How can they be brought back?  As you explore, solve inventive puzzles, and uncover clues that restore the world back to its true colors, you’ll discover this strange place at the end of an abandoned highway has deeper secrets to be revealed.

[b]When will it be released?[/b] Most likely the 2nd quarter of 2019.

[b]Is Discolored a sequel to The Search?[/b]
Discolored is not a sequel to The Search, but there are some similarities. Discolored will still feature beautiful atmospheric scenery and a similar "feel" that The Search had. The style for Discolored is very minimal, which is inspired by the painters John Register and  Edward Hopper.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28409456/e2aa7d29e9af4872cca39d94dce3ce01f7ff1a5f.jpg[/img]

[b]What will gameplay be like?[/b]
Discolored's gameplay will be using FPS controls with real-time 3D graphics, similar to modern adventure games like The Witness and Obduction, not a point-and-click with pre-rendered graphics as The Search was. Pre-rendered point-and-click games are a bit more time consuming on the art side of things which is one of the main reasons I chose to go this route, but fear not, you can expect the same quality in Discolored as you found in The Search and the puzzles actually have more variety in Discolored compared with The Search! The total gameplay time will probably clock in at around an hour or so.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28409456/5811e5646befa909dd109d8f0d993363a2d1e92b.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28409456/b6767bfc105aa52e7ed19f07a35aa763bb2c596d.jpg[/img]

Like with The Search, Discolored is being developed on my own and in my spare time. I love making these games and I thank you for your support!

If you like what you see please feel free to spread the word and please consider wishlisting the game. It would be a big help since Steam uses wishlist numbers, as well as other things, to determine what kind of visibility a game gets upon launch.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28409456/5263c1f33b84e65563fe2c2317b51fb9cce89406.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28409456/22edbec059daa841aa91773f2975b7f9d57bedb8.jpg[/img]

To stay up to date with news on Discolored you can click on the "follow" button on the game's [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/933860/Discolored/]Steam page[/url] or sign up for the newsletter through [url=http://www.jasongodbey.com/discolored]the game's website.[/url]

I would love to hear your thoughts and if you have any questions please ask in the comments section. Thanks so much!
Jason

Please let me know if you run into any issues with this update.

Thanks!
Jason
